Doskada: Grocott bo‘yalgan preparatdagi yarimoy shaklli hujayralarni sxematik chizing. Qo‘shimcha: kriptokokk o‘pka alveolalarida polimorf xamirturush ko‘rinishida; CMV yadro inklyuziyalari sil granulomasida ham ko‘rilgan. Tipik xato: PCPni bakterial pnevmoniya deb o‘ylash; Grocott bo‘yashi zamburug‘ uchun.

Doskada chizish: sil va bakterial infeksiya kesishuvini Venn diagrammasi ko‘rinishida chizing (16, 23 va 9 raqamlari bilan). Tipik xato: talabalar 59% ni ‘bitta infeksiya’ ulushi deb o‘ylaydi, aslida bu kamida ikki infeksiya ulushi.

bullets.text: Davo olmagan 6 kishining 5 tasi TB Fast Track tadqiqotining nazorat guruhida bo‘lgan. Qolgan 10 kishi davoni o‘limdan o‘rtacha 56 kun oldin boshlagan.

source.author: Karat et al.

bullets.text: Silli 16 kishining 9 tasida bakterial kasallik, 2 tasida kriptokokk infeksiyasi ham topilgan. Bu ko‘rsatkich shu 6 kishiga alohida berilmagan.

Muhokama: 1) Nazorat guruhida davoning boshlanmasligi nimani anglatadi? 2) Bakterial va qo‘shimcha infeksiyalarni gistologiyada qanday izlaymiz (ZN va Grocott bo‘yoqlari)? Doskada chizish: 16 silli kishini ‘davo olgan 10’ va ‘olmagan 6’ ga bo‘luvchi daraxt chizing. Tipik xato: 9/16 bakterial infeksiyani faqat davo olmagan 6 kishiga taalluqli deb hisoblash. Manba bu ma‘lumotni alohida bermagan.

slides.title: Natijalarni talqin qilish va MIA nazoratdagi roli

bullets.text: Vaqt o‘tishi artefakt xavfini oshirishi mumkin; jasad sovutilsa, soxta musbat natijaga ta‘siri katta bo‘lmaydi.

bullets.text: Mikrobiologik natijalar klinika va gistologiya bilan birga baholanadi; standart yo‘riqnoma tavsiya etilgan.

Doskada chizish: ushbu zanjirni (9 → +2 → +3 → 88%) chizing. Tipik xato: Xpert MTB/RIF ni ‘etarli standart’ deb hisoblash. Tadqiqotda BAL Xpert 14 tadan faqat 5 tasida musbat bo‘lgan, uchtasida kultura musbat bo‘lgan. Qo‘shimcha: M. tuberculosis o‘limdan keyin yillab va formalinda saqlanganda ham tirik qolishi mumkin.

slides.title: Eslab qoling: autopsiya tahlilining qadamlari

bullets.text: 1-qadam – namuna. Markaziy asab tizimidan (MNT) kamida 3 blok olinadi: turli bo‘laklar, bazal gangliyalar bilan gippokamp, o‘rta miya bilan ko‘prik va miyacha.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: 2-qadam – bo‘yash. Avval gematoksilin-eozin, kerak bo‘lsa maxsus bo‘yoqlar (Gram, Grocott, PAS, Luxol Fast Blue) va immunogistokimyo. Minimal invaziv autopsiyada Ziehl-Neelsen va Grocott.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: 3-qadam – talqin. Mikrobiolog har bir marhumda qaysi mikroorganizm artefakt, qaysi patogen ekanini baholaydi. Natija klinika va gistologiya bilan birga ko‘riladi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

bullets.text: 4-qadam – klinika bilan solishtirish (Goldman tasnifi). Diqqat: 1-tur ≠ 2-tur. 1-turda tirikligida aniqlansa prognoz o‘zgargan bo‘lardi, 2-turda o‘zgarmasdi.

Muhokama savollari: 1) Nega bitta blok yetarli emas? 2) Nega artefakt bilan patogenni ajratish kerak? Doskada: 4 qadamli zanjirni chizib, har qadamga bittadan misol yozdiring. Tipik xato: 1-tur va 2-tur nomuvofiqlikni aralashtirish (farq prognozga ta’siridadir).

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama savollari: 1) Nega HAART davrida ham autopsiya qimmatli? 2) MIA qanday afzallik va cheklovga ega? Doskada: ikki manbaning asosiy topilmalarini (MNT va MIA) ikki ustunda yozdiring. Tipik xato: MIA topilmasini o‘lim sababi deb talqin qilish. Karat tadqiqotida faqat patogenlar uchrashi baholangan, o‘lim sababi haqida xulosa qilinmagan.

mcq.question: Bemor birlamchi sog‘liqni saqlash muassasasida kuzatilgan, kasalxonadan tashqarida vafot etgan. Oila to‘liq autopsiyaga rozi emas. Qaysi usul eng mos?
mcq.explanation: Minimal invaziv autopsiyani (MIA) oilalar to‘liq autopsiyaga qaraganda ancha yaxshi qabul qiladi. U xavfsizroq va arzonroq, uni kasalxonadan tashqarida ham o‘tkazish mumkin. To‘liq autopsiya oltin standart, lekin qimmat, ko‘p vaqt oladi va oilalar uni kam qabul qiladi. Verbal autopsiya va guvohnoma tahlilida OIV bilan bog‘liq o‘limlarni aniqlash kamchiliklari ma’lum.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: Wilkes tadqiqotida 101 ta autopsiya tahlil qilingan. OIV bilan bog‘liq kasalliklarning necha foizi klinik jihatdan gumon qilinmagan?
mcq.explanation: Wilkes va hammualliflar 101 autopsiyada OIV bilan bog‘liq kasalliklarning 74 foizi klinik gumon qilinmaganini aniqlagan. 49% sitomegalovirusga, 20% tizimli zamburug‘ infeksiyalariga, 14% Kaposi sarkomasiga tegishli ko‘rsatkichlar bo‘lib, chalg‘ituvchi variantlardir.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Patolog OIV bilan o‘lgan bemorning markaziy nerv tizimini (MNT) standart bo‘yicha tekshirmoqda. Kamida nechta to‘qima bloki olinadi?
mcq.explanation: Standart bo‘yicha kamida uchta blok olinadi. Birinchisi turli bo‘laklardan, ikkinchisi bazal gangliyalar va gippokampdan, uchinchisi o‘rta miya, ko‘prik va miyachadan. Makroskopik o‘zgarishlar bo‘lsa, qo‘shimcha bloklar olinadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Bemor yuqori faol antiretrovirus terapiyani (HAART) boshlagan, ammo vafotidan 2 oydan ko‘proq oldin qabulni to‘xtatgan. U qaysi guruhga kiradi?
mcq.explanation: B guruhga 1–2 ta antiretrovirus dori qabul qilganlar, HAARTni 3 oydan kam ichganlar va HAARTni 2 oydan ortiq tashlab ketganlar kiradi. A guruhga hech qanday antiretrovirus dori olmaganlar, C guruhga HAARTni 3 oy va undan ko‘p qabul qilganlar kiradi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Patolog miya to‘qimasida limfoma gumon qilib, uning xarakterini aniqlamoqchi. Immunogistokimyoda qaysi to‘plam mos keladi?
options: Toxoplasma, CMV, HSV, JC virus antitanalari
CD3, CD20, CD30, CD45 markerlari to‘plami
Luxol Fast Blue, Fite Faraco usullari to‘plami
mcq.explanation: Limfomani tavsiflash uchun CD3, CD20, CD30 va CD45 monoklonal antitanalari ishlatilgan. Toxoplasma, sitomegalovirus (CMV), gerpes virusi va JC virusiga antitanalar infeksiya qo‘zg‘atuvchilarini aniqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan. Gram, Grocott va boshqa maxsus bo‘yashlar immunogistokimyo emas.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Braziliyalik 284 ta OIV (odam immunitet tanqisligi virusi) avtopsiyasi tahlilida 18 bemorda tashxis faqat o‘limdan keyin qo‘yildi. Ularning hammasida markaziy nerv tizimida (MNT) yoki boshqa a’zolarda opportunistik infeksiya topildi. Bu holat nimani ko‘rsatadi?
options: Bemorlar OIV tekshiruvidan ongli ravishda bosh tortgan
Bemorlar tibbiy yordamga kasallikning kech bosqichida kelgan
Opportunistik infeksiyalar faqat davolashdan keyin rivojlanadi
Toksoplazmoz va kriptokokkoz OIV bilan bog‘liq bo‘lmagan
mcq.explanation: Mualliflarning xulosasiga ko‘ra, tashxis o‘limdan keyin qo‘yilgan barcha 18 holatda opportunistik infeksiya bo‘lgan. Bu bemorlarning ko‘pincha tibbiy yordamga kech murojaat qilganini ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Braziliyalik 284 ta OIV/OITS avtopsiyasi seriyasida OIV yuqishining qaysi xavf omili eng ko‘p qayd etilgan (33,1%)?
mcq.explanation: Giyohvandlik 284 holatning 94 tasida (33,1%) asosiy xavf omili bo‘lgan. Gomo- yoki biseksuallik 14,1% ni tashkil etgan. Ayollar orasida OIV-musbat sherik va ko‘p jinsiy sherik 22,5% dan qayd etilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Braziliyalik 284 ta OIV avtopsiyasi tahlilida markaziy nerv tizimida (MNT) nechta holatda klinik jihatdan ahamiyatli o‘zgarishlar aniqlangan?
mcq.explanation: Ahamiyatli o‘zgarishlar 284 holatning 165 tasida (58,1%) topilgan. 103 holatda (36,3%) ahamiyatsiz o‘zgarishlar, 16 holatda (5,6%) esa mutlaqo normal miya bo‘lgan. 91 — klinik va avtopsiya tashxisi mos kelmagan holatlar soni.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Patolog Braziliyalik 284 ta OIV avtopsiyasida markaziy nerv tizimi (MNT) infeksiyalarini chastotasi bo‘yicha tartiblamoqda. Birinchi o‘rinda toksoplazmoz (29,9%). Ikkinchi o‘rinda qaysi infeksiya turadi?
mcq.explanation: Toksoplazmozdan (29,9%) keyin kriptokokkoz (15,8%) kelgan. Undan keyin yiringli bakterial infeksiyalar (3,9%), OIV ensefaliti (2,8%) va sitomegalovirus (2,5%) joylashgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Bemor yuqori faol antiretrovirus terapiyani (HAART) 3 oy va undan uzoq olgan (C guruh), uning miyasi avtopsiyada o‘rganilmoqda. A guruhga (davolanmaganlar) nisbatan C guruhda qaysi o‘zgarish ko‘proq uchragan?
options: Kriptokokkoz, uch guruhda bir xil emas
mcq.explanation: C guruhda toksoplazmoz kamroq (17,8% va 36,2%), OIV ensefaliti esa ko‘proq (11,1% va 1,8%) uchragan. Mualliflar buni HAART oluvchilarning uzoqroq yashashi bilan bog‘laydi. Kriptokokkoz guruhlar o‘rtasida o‘xshash bo‘lgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: OIV bilan kasallangan bemor vafot etdi. Autopsiyada miyada birlamchi non-Hodgkin limfomasi topildi, hayotida u gumon qilinmagan. Erta aniqlansa prognoz o‘zgarardi. Bu Goldman tasnifi bo‘yicha qaysi tur?
options: Nomuvofiqlik yo‘q: tashxis klinikaga mos edi
mcq.explanation: 1-tur xato: muhim kasallik hayotida aniqlanmagan va aniqlansa prognozni o‘zgartirishi mumkin edi. Tadqiqotda barcha limfoma holatlari shu turga kirgan. Birlamchi MNT limfomalarining birortasi ham hayotida tashxislanmagan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Bemor o‘pka infeksiyasidan vafot etdi. Autopsiyada miya toksoplazmozi topildi, uni hayotida gumon qilishmagan. Aniqlansa ham prognoz o‘zgarmasdi. Bu qaysi tur nomuvofiqlik?
options: 3-tur: kichik kasallik, ta’siri shubhali yoki yo‘q
Nomuvofiqlik yo‘q: tashxis klinikaga mos edi
mcq.explanation: 2-tur xatoda kasallik muhim, ammo hayotida aniqlansa ham prognoz o‘zgarmasdi. Muallifler bunga misol qilib o‘pka infeksiyasidan o‘lgan bemorlardagi miya toksoplazmozini keltirgan. Bunday holatlar nomuvofiqliklarning 24,2 foizini tashkil etgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Brazil tadqiqotida 1-tur xato ulushi 1996 yilgacha 62,2 foiz, keyin 48,8 foiz bo‘ldi. Mualliflar pasayishni qisman nima bilan izohlagan?
options: Autopsiyalar asosida o‘tkazilgan haftalik anatomoklinik majlislar
Barcha bemorlarning HAART qabul qilish muddati uzaygani
CD4 va virus yuklamasi har bir holatda muntazam o‘lchangani
mcq.explanation: Mualliflar kamayishni, ehtimol qisman, autopsiya natijalari muhokama qilingan haftalik anatomoklinik majlislarda olingan bilim bilan bog‘lagan. CD4 hamma holatda yo‘q edi, immunogistokimyo esa faqat ayrim holatlarda qo‘llangan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchilar poliklinikada kuzatilgan OIV-musbat kattalar o‘limidan keyin minimal invaziv autopsiya (MIA) o‘tkazmoqchi. Biopsiya uchun qaysi to‘rt a’zo asosiy nishon qilinadi?
options: Jigar, taloq, o‘ng va chap o‘pka
mcq.explanation: Karat tadqiqotida to‘qima biopsiyasi uchun jigar, taloq, o‘ng va chap o‘pka nishon qilingan. Bundan tashqari orqa miya suyuqligi, qon, siydik va bronxoalveolyar lavaj suyuqligi ham olingan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: Patolog MIA paytida olingan o‘pka kesmasida kriptokokk xamirturushlarini ko‘rsatmoqchi. Qaysi gistologik bo‘yoq zamburug‘larni aniqlash uchun ishlatilgan?
mcq.explanation: Gistologiyada mikobakteriyalarni aniqlash uchun Silga-Nilsen, zamburug‘lar uchun Grokott bo‘yog‘i ishlatilgan. Kriptokokk xamirturushlari o‘pka alveolalarida Grokott bilan ko‘rsatilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: Mikrobiolog marhumning faqat taloq namunasidan o‘sgan gramm-manfiy mikroorganizmni baholayapti. Bu topilma qanday talqin qilindi?
options: Haqiqiy patogen, chunki taloq to‘qimasi odatda steril bo‘ladi
Artefakt, chunki qorin a’zolaridan ifloslanish ehtimoli yuqori
Faqat sil bilan birga kelsa, haqiqiy patogen hisoblanadi
Artefakt, chunki taloq biopsiyasi boshqa joydan olinadi
mcq.explanation: Mualliflar faqat taloqdan ajralgan gramm-manfiy mikroorganizmlarni artefakt deb hisobladi, chunki qorin a’zolaridan ifloslanish ehtimoli katta. Talqin mikrobiolog tomonidan har marhum bo‘yicha alohida ko‘rib chiqildi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE
source.page: PMID 27829072, Methods: Data interpretation and statistical analysis

mcq.question: Patolog minimal invaziv autopsiya (MIA) to‘qima namunasida zamburug‘larni gistologik aniqlamoqchi. Qaysi bo‘yoq ishlatiladi?
mcq.explanation: Barcha to‘qima namunalarida gistologiyada mikobakteriyalar uchun ZN, zamburug‘lar uchun Grocott bo‘yog‘i ishlatilgan. Xpert esa gistologik bo‘yoq emas, BAL namunasida o‘tkazilgan molekulyar sinov.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: MIA o‘tkazilgan 34 marhumning nechtasida sil dalili topilgan va ularning qanday ulushida o‘pkadan tashqari kasallik bo‘lgan? Ikkinchi ulushni tanlang.
mcq.explanation: Sil dalili 16/34 (47%) marhumda topildi. Ularning 14 tasida (88%) o‘pkadan tashqari shakl bo‘lgan. 75% — gistologik dalil ulushi, 38% — davo boshlanmaganlar ulushi.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: Mutaxassis sil bo‘yicha nazorat uchun MIA protsedurasini soddalashtirmoqchi. Qaysi namunalar guruhi eng yuqori natija beradi?
options: Nafas yo‘llari namunalari (BAL va o‘pka to‘qimasi)
Faqat orqa miya suyuqligi (CSF) va qon
mcq.explanation: Mualliflarga ko‘ra, nafas yo‘llari namunalari (bronxoalveolyar lavaj — BAL va o‘pka to‘qimasi) sil tashxisida eng yuqori natija beradi. BAL Xpert, BAL kulturasi, o‘pka kulturasi va gistologiya birga silning 88% ini aniqlagan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

mcq.question: Autopsiyada silga xos o‘zgarishlar topilgan, lekin marhumga hayotida sil davosi boshlanmagan. Bunday 6 holatning aksariyati qaysi guruhdan edi?
options: Intervensiya guruhi, algoritm bo‘yicha davo olganlar
Intervensiya guruhi, o‘rta ehtimolli deb baholanganlar
Nazorat guruhi, standart klinika tartibida kuzatilganlar
Nazorat guruhi, OIV bo‘yicha ART olmaganlar
mcq.explanation: Sil dalili bor 16 kishining 6 tasida (38%) hayotida sil davosi boshlanmagan. Ulardan beshtasi TB Fast Track sinovining nazorat guruhiga kiritilgan, ya’ni standart klinika tartibida kuzatilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

Sababi ehtimol bemorlarning uzoqroq yashashi: opportunistik infeksiyalar o‘rnini OIV o‘zi keltirgan o‘zgarishlar egallaydi.

extras.text: Qiziqarli fakt: miyadagi ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar OIV infeksiyasi uchun “patognomonik” hisoblanadi. Braziliya ishida OIV ensefaliti immunogistokimyosiz, faqat shu hujayralarni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ko‘rish orqali aniqlangan. Mualliflarcha, bu uning kam uchrashiga qisman sabab bo‘lgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

source.author: Silva et al.

extras.text: Eslab qoling (gistologik bo‘yoqlar): Ziehl-Neelsen (ZN) bo‘yog‘i mikobakteriyalarni, Grocott bo‘yog‘i zamburug‘larni ko‘rsatadi. Minimal invaziv autopsiyada (MIA) o‘pka, jigar va taloqdan olingan to‘qimalar shu bo‘yoqlar bilan tekshirilgan. Gistologiyada o‘pkada kriptokokk xamirturushlari ko‘rinadi, Pneumocystis esa yarim oy shaklli zamburug‘ sifatida namoyon bo‘ladi.
